title: Tianqing Reborn
next_chapter_hook: "Su Qingyao softly told Chen Ji: the mastermind behind the humiliation of that broken engagement years ago was not far away, but hidden by his side—a person he had never suspected."

text.content: "At the moment the spatial rift closed completely, Chen Ji felt a sharp pang in his chest—that was the signal of his Heavenly Fate Value draining away once more. His lifespan had been reduced by another three years. Dusk shrouded the shattered Tianqing mountain range, the air thick with the mingled scent of scorched earth and blood. He raised his hand to press against his chest, fingertips touching the worn Tianji Record hidden beneath his robes, its pages warm as a newborn pulse. Mo Xiansheng's sigh echoed in the depths of his consciousness, but he did not turn back. He simply gazed at the sect's main hall slowly being rebuilt in the distance, a faint smile flickering across his eyes."

dialogue.content: "Are you certain you can afford this price?"
"Even if I can't afford it, I must pay. Mo Xiansheng, in this world, some debts cannot be measured in lifespan."

text.content: "Three days later, the Tianqing Sect's Mountain Gate was barely restored to its former appearance with the assistance of imperial reinforcements. The blue stone steps were laid flat inch by inch, broken pillars replaced with newly cut spiritual wood, and the air carried the scent of fresh lacquer and sandalwood. Chen Ji stood before the newly renovated scripture archive, watching the servant disciples coming and going, his lips slightly raised. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul, nurtured over three days, finally slowly manifested from the first page of the Tianji Record, coalescing into a wisp of pale golden mist that formed a vague humanoid shape beside Chen Ji."

dialogue.content: "Young Sect Master, you've only slept two hours in these three days. The body is capital. Don't think this old man doesn't know how many times you've secretly used the Tianji Record."
"Mo Xiansheng, your remnant soul body needs rest even more. Don't worry, I know what I'm doing."

text.content: "Just then, an Inner Disciple rushed over, excitement barely hidden in his expression: 'Chen Senior Brother! Su Senior Sister has awakened! The Sect Master Uncle wants you to come!' Chen Ji's steps paused briefly, and that usual lazy glint in his eyes finally showed a barely perceptible flicker. He straightened his faded disciple robes and walked toward the Inner Sect residence. Behind him, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sighed silently, turning into a thread of golden light that sank deep into the Tianji Record."

dialogue.content: "Three years. I've chased you for three years, Chen Ji."

text.content: "The Inner Sect residence was filled with the bitter scent of medicinal herbs. Su Qingyao reclined against the headboard, her complexion pale and nearly translucent. Those eyes, once sharp as swords, were now shrouded in a layer of mist. She watched Chen Ji enter, then suddenly smiled—a smile carrying the first release and exhaustion she had never shown in three years. Chen Ji sat on the wooden stool by her bed and spoke after a long silence: 'Senior Sister Su, you've worked hard.' Su Qingyao shook her head, reaching out to gently grasp his sleeve, her fingertips cool: 'Don't call me Senior Sister anymore. Call me Qingyao.'"

dialogue.content: "Do you know? I've investigated everything about you. Thetrash's rise three years ago, every victory in the past five years, every seemingly coincidental yet meticulously planned move... I thought finding the truth would make me hate you, hate you for deceiving everyone. But now I only want to ask you one thing."
"Is there still a place beside you for someone who can stand shoulder to shoulder with you?"

choice.prompt: "How should Chen Ji respond to Su Qingyao's declaration of love like thunder?"

choices.description: "Tell her that he has been waiting for someone who could see through all his disguises and still be willing to stand by him."
choices.visible_reward: "Su Qingyao's favorability has greatly increased, unlocking the prerequisite for 'Shared Destiny'"
choices.risk_hint: "Her deeper understanding also means increased danger"

dialogue.content: "Three years of pursuit, three years without giving up... Qingyao, do you know? I have been waiting for someone who could see through all my disguises and still be willing to stand by my side."

text.content: "Su Qingyao's eyes instantly reddened. She said nothing, only gripping Chen Ji's hand tightly, as if pouring all the grievances and obsession of these three years into that single clasp. The sunset slanted through the window, golden light spilling over their intertwined hands, warm and peaceful."

choices.memory_label: 青瑶的告白与陈机的接纳

choices.description: "Use his usual world-weary attitude to conceal the turmoil within, not letting her see his vulnerability."
choices.visible_reward: "Maintain the sense of mystery, not exposing inner weaknesses"

dialogue.content: "Is Miss Qingyao confessing to thistrash? Alas, what virtue do I possess to deserve this... However, if Miss doesn't嫌弃, perhaps after I finish playing this game of chess over the world, I might consider it."

text.content: "Su Qingyao's smile froze for a moment, then she withdrew her hand, turning her face toward the window. After a long while, she quietly said: 'Chen Ji, when will you be willing to speak a word of truth to me?' The voice was so soft it was almost inaudible, yet it struck Chen Ji's heart heavily."

choices.memory_label: 陈机的回避与青瑶的失落

text.content: "Seven days later, the Xuanwu Sect's surrender document arrived at the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate. Chen Ji, in his capacity as Imperial Grand Preceptor, sat high on the guest seat, watching that disheveled Xuanwu Sect Elder prostrate on the ground, holding the surrender document high above his head with both hands. The once invincible number one sect of Xuanwu now had only these thousand-odd remnant soldiers and defeated generals. Chen Ji did not speak immediately, merely lifting his tea cup to gently blow on the hot steam. The hall was so silent one could hear the faint sound of the tea cooling."

dialogue.content: "Imperial Grand Preceptor, the entire Xuanwu Sect is willing to submit to the empire, never to betray! We beg the great official for mercy, to take us in!"
"What about Han Lie? Your number one prodigy?"

"Han... Han Senior Brother left alone three days ago, leaving a letter behind saying he would not rest as a man until he avenged this humiliation. The letter also said... said that one day he would personally take Chen Ji's head."

text.content: "Chen Ji set down the tea cup and suddenly laughed lightly. That laughter echoed through the silent hall, carrying an indecipherable meaning of either contempt or amusement. He rose, walked slowly to that Elder, and looked down at his trembling form: 'Han Lie wants to kill me? I actually look forward to that day. But before then—' He extended his hand and took the surrender document, 'The remaining Xuanwu Sect disciples shall be incorporated into the imperial reserve forces, uniformly dispatched by this Grand Preceptor. Go back and tell them, Tianqing Sect does not hold grudges, but if there is any sign of double-heartedness...' He paused, a cold light flashing in his eyes, 'On this Grand Preceptor's chessboard, there are never traitors.'"

choice.prompt: "The Xuanwu Sect's surrender is已成定局, how should Chen Ji handle these thousand-odd surrendered soldiers?"

choices.description: "Select promising young disciples for key cultivation, disperse the rest into various sects, letting the name Xuanwu completely disappear from history."
choices.visible_reward: "Gain a batch of loyal new generation forces, eliminate the hidden danger of Xuanwu Sect"
choices.risk_hint: "Some may pay lip service while harboring different intentions"

text.content: "The Elder heard this and continuously kowtowed, thanking him profusely before retreating. Chen Ji turned to gaze out the window. On the distant horizon, the morning sun was slowly rising. He lightly tapped the Tianji Record, and Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul appeared once more: 'Young Sect Master, the chess game has entered the middle game. What is your next move?'"

choices.text: "Slaughter the chicken to frighten the monkey"
choices.description: "Publicly execute a few stubborn elements, causing the remaining surrendered soldiers to feel fear, ensuring absolute control."
choices.visible_cost: "May chill the hearts of other forces"
choices.visible_reward: "Maximize short-term control, no one dares to have different intentions"

text.content: "The moment Chen Ji's voice fell, two long blades descended simultaneously, and three Xuanwu Sect disciples were instantly beheaded. Blood dyed the blue stone floor crimson. All the surrendered soldiers present turned ashen, trembling uncontrollably. He looked down at everything from above, his eyes showing not the slightestfluctuation: 'I said it before, on this Grand Preceptor's chessboard, there are never traitors.'"

"Another three days passed, and a grand heaven-worshipping ceremony was held before the Tianqing Sect's main hall. Officials sent by the empire, survivors from the three great sects of the age, and tens of thousands of wandering cultivators and mortals gathered before the newly repaired Mountain Gate. Chen Ji stood atop the high platform, overlooking the myriad beings below, yet in his heart he was quietly calculating something. Su Qingyao stood not far behind him, her gaze always following that somewhat frail figure. When she first saw Chen Ji three years ago, she had thought him beyond salvation—atrash; now she finally understood that the truetrash, from beginning to end, had only been herself."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, there is something I must tell you."
"Regarding that incident where you were broken off from and humiliated over an engagement years ago... I have found the whereabouts of the mastermind."
"That person... is hidden by your side. Someone you have never suspected."

text.content: "Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Above the platform, the ceremonial bells for worshipping heaven rang悠悠, the believers' cheers surged like tides, yet in his ears there remained only the resonance of Su Qingyao's words. Three years—he had laid plans for three years, calculating every hero under heaven, yet had never suspected the people beside him. In the distance, the old Sect Master Ling Yuan was gazing at him with a kind smile, that smile so benevolent and gentle, just like when they first met three years ago. Chen Ji slowly收回目光, quietly saying to Su Qingyao: 'Tell me, who it is.' His voice was very light, as if casually asking, yet the fist clenched in his sleeve had already revealed the turbulent waves within his heart."
